requirement.title: EU AI Act training requirement
requirement.description: Decide whether members of your organization need to complete the EU AI Act training in the Academy before they can use Ayunis Core chat. Reading existing chats is never blocked.
requirement.error: Could not update the training requirement
requirement.errorUnexpected: Something went wrong while saving. Please try again.

unrestricted.label: Not required
unrestricted.description: Everyone can use chat straight away. The Academy stays available on a voluntary basis.

requiredOnce.label: Required once
requiredOnce.description: Members must complete the EU AI Act training before using chat. Once completed, it never expires.

requiredAnnually.label: Required every year
requiredAnnually.description: Members must complete the EU AI Act training before using chat and renew it every 12 months. Renewing means completing the whole Academy again.

overview.title: Training status by member
overview.description: Who has completed the EU AI Act training, when they completed it, and who needs attention. Members whose renewal is due within 30 days count as expiring soon.
overview.emptyDescription: Clear the search or status filter to see everyone.
